2607.25471.title: TRWH: A Text-Driven Random Walk Heterogeneous GNN for Semantic-Aware Sparse Recommendation
2607.25471.paper_summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) have each advanced recommendation systems by modeling structural and semantic signals, respectively. However, integrating their complementary strengths remains challenging, particularly in sparse settings where maintaining semantic precision is critical. We propose TRWH (Text-driven Random Walk Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network), a novel framework that fuses LLM-generated textual profiles with heterogeneous graph structures through strategic random walk augmentation. TRWH consists of three core components: (1) Embedding Creation, which produces user and item representations using both Word2Vec and LLM-based profiling; (2) a Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (HeteroGNN) that propagates information across multi-relational edges; and (3) Random Walk-based Path Construction, which enriches sparse graphs with second-order user-user and item-item links. Experiments on the Amazon-2023 Fashion (2M users, 825K items) and Beauty (631K users, 112K items) datasets demonstrate that TRWH achieves substantial performance gains over state-of-the-art methods, including 80.0% RMSE and 52.6% MAE reductions on Fashion, and 25.7% and 10.8% improvements on Beauty. Notably, while random walks improve performance with traditional embeddings, they can dilute the nuanced representations learned by LLMs, underscoring the importance of adaptive integration strategies.
2607.25471.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡（GNNs）和大型語言模型（LLMs）各自通過建模結構和語義信號來推進推薦系統。然而，整合它們的互補優勢仍然具有挑戰性，特別是在稀疏環境中，保持語義精確性至關重要。我們提出了TRWH（文本驅動隨機漫遊異構圖神經網絡），這是一個新穎的框架，通過戰略性隨機漫遊增強將LLM生成的文本檔案與異構圖結構融合。TRWH由三個核心組件組成：（1）嵌入創建，使用Word2Vec和基於LLM的檔案生成用戶和項目表示；（2）異構圖神經網絡（HeteroGNN），在多關係邊上傳播信息；以及（3）基於隨機漫遊的路徑構建，通過二階用戶-用戶和項目-項目鏈接豐富稀疏圖。對Amazon-2023時尚（200萬用戶，82.5萬項目）和美容（63.1萬用戶，11.2萬項目）數據集的實驗表明，TRWH在性能上顯著超越了最先進的方法，包括在時尚領域實現80.0%的RMSE和52.6%的MAE減少，以及在美容領域實現25.7%和10.8%的改進。值得注意的是，儘管隨機漫遊在傳統嵌入中提高了性能，但它們可能稀釋LLMs學習到的細緻表示，這突顯了自適應整合策略的重要性。
2607.25471.author: He Ma et.al.
